remarks: Privately situated, end-unit Newer, Spacious townhome in Desirable Palmer Square - Mere Steps and you're on the Path to the popular public Golf Course! Enjoy life in a Pet Friendly community with economic gas heat, central air + No ADDITIONAL FEES! This well appointed home offers its own private entrance, extra windows, hardwood flooring & fab designer kitchen with granite countertops & stainless appliances! Door from dining area leads to the patio overlooking the trees and stone wall. Come see this immaculately presented bright space, wonderfully situated within the complex! In-Unit Washer/Dryer located on the 2nd floor. Beautifully maintained community features: On-Site Management, 24-Hour Security & Parking for 2-Cars. Pets are welcome with the following guidelines 2 Dogs 35 Lbs., 1 Dog 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. $300 fully refundable pet deposit per pet required. Palmer Square is a No Smoking Community. Interested parties please complete a Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements, and supply a credit check through Applyconnect only.
